title: Change the organisation's name or contact person on a business E-Toll Account
summary: Learn how to change an organisation's name or contact person associated with a business E-Toll account at a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
If you need to change the name of an organisation or a contact person associated with a Transport for NSW E-Toll business account, you can do this at a Service NSW Centre.

Note: If the Australian Business Number (ABN) has changed, you’ll need to:
what_you_need: A letter on the organisation's letterhead, signed by the current account holder, a manager, director, or CEO of the company.
The organisation change of name certificate from the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC).
